sentences.text: For this floating-rate business loan to an MSE, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh.
The case facts show the loan was sanctioned on 15 March 2026 and the amount is ₹40 lakh, and those facts match the applied Tier 3 UCB rule.
R2 says pre-payment charge is permitted, but R1 and R3 say it is not permitted for this case.
